release_notes:
- Device communication now uses the actual USB Debug port identifier instead of a fixed default, reducing "Device not connected" errors after reconnects
- Added USB event suppression during write operations on Audio, DMC, and PS Key 299 tabs to prevent false disconnect notifications
- Added CUSTOMER295 byte vector editor in the PS Key 299 tab (8 editable hex bytes with auto-advance)
- Read and Write operations in the PS Key 299 tab now handle both CUSTOMER299 and CUSTOMER295 together
- Read and Write buttons in the PS Key 299 tab moved to the right side for consistency
- Firmware versions with only one variant available (headset or kido) now show correctly instead of staying on "Fetching" forever
- Firmware versions where no variant exists on Z: drive now show "not available" instead of "Fetching" indefinitely
